note: Set A correctly separates the wiring-schedule entries (33 = 6#10, #10G.; 34 = 6#10, 3#10G.; 32 = 2#10USE-2; 31 = 2#10, #10G.) and captures note facts such as the 200A/2P NFDS NEMA 3R enclosure and the 120/240V system voltage. Set B misbinds '3W' as the sub-panel main breaker rating (the note gives 50A/2P, 3W being the 3-wire descriptor), assigns ARMORED CABLE to symbol 151 when it belongs to 150, and quotes a fabricated 'SUB-PANEL (2) … 1 PH' string plus a truncated duplicate 'MAIN SERVICE P' claim. Both sets repeat the same bogus 'PV Equipment quantity 50' claim and A adds two trivial identifier claims plus an unsupported 5-to-31 connection, but A's remaining claims are more consistently bound to the right schedule rows and notes.
